description: Given a wallet and target weights (e.g. 50% ETH on Ethereum, 50% USDC on Base), compute the swaps needed from its current holdings, each with a LIVE SwapChan quote (quoteId → build_swap_tx) and a prefilled swapUrl. Unpriced holdings are left alone. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
